title: Watoga State Park Cabin Renovations
overview: MEP renovations to both the original CCC-era cabins and the newer modern cabins at Watoga State Park — full electrical and plumbing upgrades throughout, kitchen and bath renovations in the modern cabins, and a new dining room for the CCC cabins. Ductless heat-pump split systems now let the once-seasonal CCC cabins rent year-round, with tankless water heaters suiting their small footprints.
